note: Curated visual themes tied to canonical research ids; order is editorial, not exact chronology. Artwork is original symbolic illustration and not documentary depiction.

stages.title: Old Saturn
stages.subtitle: The warmth condition · the first physical germ
scenes: A world-condition of living warmth, before familiar solids or oceans.
Spirits of Will are described as giving of their own being to form the first bodily foundation.
The future physical body begins as a warmth organization, not mineral flesh.
Steiner connects manifest time with the earliest outward warmth condition.
Spiritual beings contribute formative activities at different phases, without displacing one another.
Fire Spirits work with germinal sense possibilities, not completed physical organs.
Consciousness is compared to the dimmest mineral-like state.
The first condition passes into rest, preserving its accomplishments for Old Sun.

stages.title: Old Sun
stages.subtitle: Life and etheric organization
scenes: Saturn Reborn in a New Form
The former Saturn condition returns in transformed fashion as a foundation.
Spirits of Wisdom impart the germ of the etheric body.
A new air- or gas-like element is described alongside warmth.
Light is described as emerging with the Sun condition.
The human germ takes on life-processes compared to plant growth, not literal leaves.
Several orders of spiritual beings elaborate the evolving organization.
The human germ's consciousness is likened to sleep rather than waking awareness.
The later Life-Spirit principle is traced to a germinal beginning.

stages.title: Old Moon
stages.subtitle: Astral organization and picture-consciousness
scenes: Old Moon begins by recapitulating Saturn and Sun achievements.
The Spirits of Movement contribute the astral organization.
Watery or fluid character joins older warmth and air tendencies.
Differentiated cosmic spheres allow distinct spiritual influences to operate.
An inner responsiveness of sympathy, antipathy and feeling develops.
Consciousness is described as picture-forming rather than conceptual thought.
Multiple levels of development coexist in Steiner's account.
New inner members and a germ of Spirit-Self are placed in this stage.

stages.title: Earth
stages.subtitle: The human I and the growth of moral freedom
scenes: Earth first reworks the Saturn, Sun and Moon inheritance.
Steiner associates the Earth condition with mineral solidity.
The self-conscious I becomes the distinctive task of Earth evolution.
A new relation to objects replaces earlier predominantly inward images.
Earth contains seven nested great epochs rather than only one human culture.
Steiner places the separation of the Moon within early Earth evolution.
Steiner describes vivid pictorial memory in his Atlantean narrative.
The earthly moral task transforms inherited wisdom through freedom and love.

stages.title: Future Jupiter
stages.subtitle: A projected new earthly metamorphosis
scenes: Steiner projects a metamorphosed future embodiment after a cosmic interval.
Earlier cosmic states are recapitulated before Jupiter's distinct advance.
The projected awareness combines living images with self-conscious clarity.
The former mineral kingdom does not persist as the same kind of kingdom.
The differentiated kingdoms have changed from their earthly forms.
The outcome of earthly moral work becomes significant for the future.
Steiner describes assistance to differently developed souls as part of this stage.
The account describes a new interval of external solar influence.

stages.title: Future Venus
stages.subtitle: Further metamorphosis and inspired consciousness
scenes: A renewed Sun–Jupiter union precedes this later condition.
Future Venus follows Jupiter as a new planetary metamorphosis.
Steiner's lowest surviving kingdom is no longer a separate plant kingdom.
Steiner pictures several differently developed human levels.
Future Venus consciousness is likened to spiritual Inspiration and inner tone.
A new creative dimension accompanies future awareness.
New relations to solar influence are described, not present-day astronomy.
Steiner projects a separate sphere for beings resisting further evolution.

stages.title: Future Vulcan
stages.subtitle: Intuition, individuality and the limits of description
scenes: Vulcan is the last named great condition in the sevenfold sequence.
Steiner presents this as a remotely projected outcome, not an available exact picture.
Intuition describes entering inwardly into the life of spiritual reality.
Steiner stresses that individuality is not lost in this future awareness.
The seventh state is described as intuitive rather than ordinary visual awareness.
GA 13 explicitly limits how much can be described about this condition.
A later lecture uses the whole-world-union image for this far-future culmination.
The available sources do not provide an exhaustive chronology beyond Vulcan.
